_meta.description: Collector-derived contract for the multipage tests matrix view. Schema v3 derives branch-safe current and historical lifecycle evidence from immutable qa-run-v1 snapshots, with a deliberate legacy result compatibility projection.

summary_metrics.label: Published matrix rows
summary_metrics.derivation: Count rows emitted by the collector for the tests matrix.

summary_metrics.label: Rows with completed runs
summary_metrics.derivation: Count fresh terminal qa-run-v1 rows and legacy rows with a completed passed/failed result; exclude running and stale evidence.

summary_metrics.label: Rows waiting for results
summary_metrics.derivation: Count matrix rows still marked unavailable after joining published results and enrollment issues.

summary_metrics.label: Flaky matrix rows
summary_metrics.derivation: Count matrix rows with at least two pass/fail status flips in their recorded run history.

summary_metrics.label: Rows with canonical QA-run evidence
summary_metrics.derivation: Count rows derived from exact single-suite immutable qa-run-v1 snapshots.
